_comment: Species that borrow another species' technique effect points. For a technique whose EFE table has no row for `species`, its `donor` row is used, scaled by scale[0]/scale[1]: bone 0 stays a point in front of the Digimon; an `origins` entry whose `from` matches [bone, x, y, z] (bone -2 = any bone, x 32767 = any offset) gives its `to`; `bones` maps each donor bone to the species' own; flag same_rig keeps the bone; flag fallback uses `fallback`; flag always uses it even when the donor has no row. Entries of a species are tried in order, the first that gives a point wins. At most 16 entries, 24 origins, 48 bones.

effectDonors.note: Cherrymon borrows Piximon's row (the other Earth Ultimate). Bone 0: 1.6 times farther (550 high against 330); bone 11 (Piximon's spear hand: Green Trap, the thrown Bit Bomb): the palm of Cherrymon's front hand, also bone 11; anything else (the powders, Bug, Insect Plague), and a table without Piximon: Cherrymon's mouth, in front of trunk bone 2.
King of Sukamon is Sukamon (same skeleton) built 2.76 times larger, shrunk to 0.62 by its partner model: 1.71 times Sukamon.
Icemon has its own rows for Megaton Punch, Giga Freeze and Ice Needle. Tremar and Buster Dive: Gotsumon's (the same model, 280 high).
Ice Statue, Winter Blast, Muscle Charge: Agumon's (the same bones, 250 high; SnowAgumon uses Agumon's rows).
Subzero Ice Punch: Frigimon's (380 high): its point in front of Icemon (bone 0, scaled), any other Frigimon bone to Icemon's head.
Meteormon has its own rows for Magma Bomb, Meltdown, Megaton Punch and Tremar. Buster Dive: Gotsumon's.
Spit Fire, Heat Laser, Red Inferno, Prominence Beam, Fireball: Meramon's (the same bones, its animations are Meramon's).

ShogunGekomon <- Whamon (440/400 high): Whamon's head points become the mouth (head bone 4, in front of the jaw: Giga Freeze, Water Blit, Ice Needle), its body point (Aurora Freeze) the hips, and Blasting Spout leaves from the bell of a trumpet (bone 7). Offsets are in model axes (0.55 times the NPC's mesh).
Myotismon <- Devimon: Sonic Jab and Death Claw leave from bone 0 (430/400 high); a donor row with no explicit origin starts from the fallback.
WaruMonzaemon <- Monzaemon (410/330 high): Electric Cloud above the head, Megalo Spark and Lovely Attack before the chest, Confused Storm from the claw arm.

Jijimon <- Ogremon (250/390 high): Ogremon's bones 1-17 -> Jijimon's (head and jaw -> face, club -> staff). A bone map: the donor bone to the bone that plays its part in the retargeted animation, the offset scaled.
Analogman <- Andromon (350/400 high): Andromon's bones 1-20 -> Analogman's (the shoulder joints to the torso, each arm and leg piece to his).
